messages:
lina (support): customer reports /v1/rerank returning 413 with vague message 'input size exceeded'. they hit it when sending a single query + ~600 docs.

maria (CSE): wow that's a lot. which SDK / region? any example payload?

lina (support): js-sdk from eu-west, but reproduced with curl locally. error body is just: 

```
HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
{
  \"error\": \"input size exceeds server limit\"
}
```

omar (eng): 600 docs will blow past any token ceiling. do we surface which piece caused the overflow? right now it's aggregate only.

lina (support): customer asked for clearer guidance and a small repro they can run. they're blocked for a POC.

omar (eng): requests are measured as tokens(query) + tokens(concatenated documents). we should confirm limit values in docs but also improve UX.

rachel (product): proposal: change message to include the failed dimension (tokens/char/doc_count) and an example short action: e.g., 'Reduce documents or truncate documents.' also provide a one-line curl they can run to reproduce locally.

maria (CSE): can we include a tiny code snippet that clients can drop in to chunk docs and re-rank? would save a ton of back-and-forth.

lina (support): i pasted a minimal repro they used (sanitized):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    \"query\": \"List best onboarding steps for a new PM\",
    \"documents\": [\"<doc1>\", \"<doc2>\", \"...\" /* ~600 items */]
  }'
```

lina (support): they reported average doc length ~700 chars, query ~1.2k chars.

omar (eng): quick math: 600 * 700 chars ~ 420k chars + query -> tokenization will push this further. server limit is roughly 1M chars equivalent in our config. this should hit the ceiling.

omar (eng): engineering ideas:
- return a structured error: { code: \"INPUT_TOO_LARGE\", reason: \"token_ceiling\", max: \"X tokens\", actual_estimate: \"Y tokens\", field: \"documents\" }
- optionally include index of a first offending document (e.g., documents[412]) for easier triage (privacy-safe if we only expose index).

rachel (product): product accepts structured error. make recommended friendly wording too. suggested UX message: 

\"Request rejected: combined size of query + documents (estimated X tokens) exceeds the allowed limit (Y tokens). Try reducing the number of documents, shorten documents, or prefilter results before calling rerank. For examples and client-side chunking code see https://redwood.example/docs/rerank/limits\"

maria (CSE): sample JS helper to chunk by characters (safe simple heuristic) they asked for — i pasted this inline for support replies: 

```
function chunkDocsByChars(docs, maxChars=100000) {
  const out = [];
  let bucket = [];
  let size = 0;
  for (const d of docs) {
    if (size + d.length > maxChars) { out.push(bucket); bucket = []; size = 0; }
    bucket.push(d);
    size += d.length;
  }
  if (bucket.length) out.push(bucket);
  return out; // list of document batches
}
```

lina (support): customer-facing reply drafted: 

\"Thanks — the rerank call rejected your request because the combined size of query+documents exceeded the platform limit. Options: 1) reduce number of documents, 2) shorten/trim documents, 3) run a cheap filter (embedding or keyword) to preselect top ~200 docs and then rerank. Attached is a small chunking snippet and a curl example to reproduce. If you'd like, we can increase tolerance for paid Dedicated customers — file a ticket.\"

omar (eng): implementation notes: structured error and including failing field index is doable. will open infra ticket to add a counter + early return with field index. beware: for very large lists we shouldn't iterate extra times — do streaming size estimate.

rachel (product): also suggest adding a distinct error code for \"DOC_COUNT_EXCEEDED\" when count > N, so clients can short-circuit.

lina (support): customer wants ETA — can we push a support-friendly stopgap: change wording of 413 to include a short human tip (1 line) while eng implements structured error?

omar (eng): yes. i'll add a quick UX change to error text (no schema change) in the next patch. ticket INF-5489.

deploy-bot: rolled out patch to staging with improved 413 copy (staging) :rocket:

maria (CSE): awesome. i'll send the customer the repro + suggested workaround and ask if they'd like dedicated capacity. :thumbsup:

lina (support): leaving this thread with action items:
- OMAR: INF-5489 add better 413 copy and start work on structured error (est 3 sprints)
- OMAR: quick perf-safe field-index hint in response when possible
- RACHEL: docs snippet + link for support KB
- MARIA: share workaround + chunking snippet with customer

rachel (product): added PRD note and will follow up with KB link.

lina (support): marking resolved for now, re-open if customer still blocked after suggested fixes. :eyes:
